name: All Community Outreach (ACO)
hoursNotes: Mon/Tue/Thu are choice-shopping appointments; Friday is drive-thru pickup. Visits by appointment after online application approval.
requirements: Complete the online application; approved clients may shop once per month. Serves Collin County residents. For emergency food, call or visit during business hours.
notes: Formerly Allen Community Outreach. Also offers rent and utility assistance, GED classes, and career services.
